label: Claude Opus 5.5
output:
To: rhonda@lindenpikediner.example
Replying to: none
Cc: none
Subject: drivers christmas breakfast 2026

Hi Rhonda its Gary from the bus garage again. Hard to believe its that time already. We want to do the christmas breakfast at your place like always if you'll have us. Saturday Dec 19 in the back room, 7am same as always. If the 19th is no good the 12th would work too, but we'd really like the 19th if you can do it and I'll explain why down below.

Dwayne got the sign up sheet off the board in the drivers room and its 19 drivers, 3 from the shop, and Earl and his wife Carol, so 24 counting them. Bigger than last year. Same setup if thats ok, the big pans of eggs, home fries and biscuits and gravy family style and everybody orders there own meat off the menu. Last year it was $11 a head which was more than fair. If its gone up a little this year thats fine, I know everything costs more now, just let me know what the number is so I can tell everybody. And separate checks again please, that worked good last time.

A couple of things about people this year.

Lonnie is on a walker now since his hip, so he needs to come in the side door with no steps. Is that door going to be open that morning, or should he knock or call when he gets there? I just want to make sure he isn't stuck out in the cold or trying to do the steps.

Patsy cant do eggs anymore. Could you do her some oatmeal or pancakes or whatever you've got that works? She's not picky she just cant have the eggs. Would that be part of the $11 or does she order off the menu?

Now the big one. Earl is retiring. He's drove for 31 years and his last day is Friday the 18th, the day before the breakfast, so thats why the 19th means a lot. He does NOT know we're doing anything so please keep it quiet if he calls or comes in. Carol is in on it. She says he'd be embarrassed if we made a big speech but he'd love it if the guys did something for him.

So heres my question. Would it be ok if we brought in a cake from Sugarcreek Bakery? Or, and honestly I think he'd like this better, could you do a big tray of your cinnamon rolls with a candle in one? Carol says he loves them and I'll be honest yours are better than any cake I ever had. If you can do the rolls, how many would we need for 24 and what would that run? If you'd rather we bring the cake thats fine too, I just didn't want to show up with one without asking. I'd have to order it by about the 14th either way since they want 5 days notice.

And this is me asking real nice. Last year the coffee ran out about 8:15 when the urn quit. I know you felt bad about it and I know these things happen, nobody held it against you. But with this being Earls breakfast and a bigger group, would you be able to have a backup coffee pot going just in case? Bus drivers on a Saturday morning without coffee can get ugly lol. You said in your note you'd have a backup next time so I figure your already on it, just checking.

So to sum up what I need to know:
- is the 19th open, and if not the 12th
- price per head this year
- the side door for Lonnie
- what you can do for Patsy
- cake from Sugarcreek or a tray of your cinnamon rolls, and how many and how much
- backup coffee pot

I'll get you the final count by the Wednesday before like you want, that would be Wednesday the 16th. If somebody drops off or adds on I'll let you know then.

Thanks Rhonda, we always look forward to this one and the guys all said your place or nowhere. Merry Christmas to you and your crew.

Gary Hollins
